title: pointToCell
body:
## pointToCell

Averages point arrays onto cells: each cell receives the unweighted mean of its points' values. The mesh is unchanged; only the array association changes. Use it when a later operation, a threshold or an integration needs cell data, or to compare with cell-centred solver output. Use cellToPoint for the reverse.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Averaging over cell points smooths peaks; the cell values are not exact cell integrals.
- With passPointData true (Schemaxis default) both versions of each array remain; select the association explicitly downstream.

Native constructor: `PointDatatoCellData`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `passPointData` | Retain the original point arrays alongside the new cell arrays. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `allArrays` | Process all available input arrays. Disable this and specify arrays to restrict the conversion. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `arrays` | Names of arrays to convert when allArrays is false. They must exist on the input association. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Conditional requirements:

```json
[
  {
    "when": [
      "allArrays",
      false
    ],
    "option": "arrays"
  }
]
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pointToCell",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
